📢 On December 2, 2026 at 10:00 Chișinău time, the Online #Infoshare for the Moldovan community on #OpenInternetStack (OIS) Calls will take place. 🤓

#OIS provides financial #support for free and #opensource projects. 🤝 Project proposals should have #research and #development as their primary objective. 👍️️️️️
This session will cover the scope, eligibility, and assessment procedures, and give an opportunity to ask your questions. 🎯
